details.costs: Study one round/0.2 energy. Examine one round/0.5 energy with no root. Plant additionally requires root-planting-trial mastery and one exact owned unspoiled root; first round examines/reserves, then two paid work rounds at1 energy each. Missing/invalid root fails before charge. Source bound to Moss and surface-38-moss-234; exact processId for resume/cancel.
details.effects: Require complete conserved surface/deposit provenance, actual completed exposure of the original forest floor and nine current dry soil/forest substrate samples, in addition to live physical clearance and reach. This minimal mechanical placement case is not fertility, hardness or viability certification; unsupported substrate remains unknown. Preserve deposit matter. Exact root escrow and paid work persist; conflicts pause before further cost. Cancel/death releases surviving unplanted root on the actual ground once. Completed placement retains one planted-unverified specimen and ages normally. No growth, harvest, reward, free material, maintenance or automatic mastery.
